I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact spot‑price right now.  
The most accurate way to get the current BTC/USD rate is to look at one of the major crypto exchanges (e.g., Coinbase, Binance) or an aggregated pricing site such as:

* **CoinGecko** – https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin  
* **CoinMarketCap** – https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/  

These sites update their prices several times per second and will show you both the latest bid/ask spread and the last traded price. If you’re building something programmatically, many exchanges offer public APIs where you can pull the ticker data directly.
